name: Karakeep
description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
composeYaml:
services:
  web:
    image: 'ghcr.io/karakeep-app/karakeep:release'
    volumes:
      - 'karakeep-data:/data'
    environment:
      - 'NEXTAUTH_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - 'NEXTAUTH_SECRET=${KARAKEEPNEXTAUTH_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MEILI_MASTER_KEY=${MEILI_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MEILI_ADDR=http://meilisearch:7700'
      - 'BROWSER_WEB_URL=http://chrome:9222'
      - 'OPENAI_API_KEY=${SERVICE_OPENAI_API_KEY}'
      - 'DISABLE_SIGNUPS=${SERVICE_DISABLE_SIGNUPS:-false}'
      - DATA_DIR=/data
  chrome:
    image: 'gcr.io/zenika-hub/alpine-chrome:124'
    command:
      - '--no-sandbox'
      - '--disable-gpu'
      - '--disable-dev-shm-usage'
      - '--remote-debugging-address=0.0.0.0'
      - '--remote-debugging-port=9222'
      - '--hide-scrollbars'
  meilisearch:
    image: 'getmeili/meilisearch:v1.13.3'
    environment:
      - 'MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS=${MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS:-true}'
      - 'NEXTAUTH_SECRET=${KARAKEEPNEXTAUTH_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MEILI_MASTER_KEY=${MEILI_PASSWORD}'
      - 'NEXTAUTH_URL=${APP_URL}'
    volumes:
      - 'karakeep-meilisearch:/meili_data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:7700/health'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15

meta.about: Bookmark-everything app with a touch of AI for the data hoarders out there.
